mathematics.assertion_tested: On uniquely matched COSMOS sources, determine whether FASHI DR2 integrated HI flux agrees with the MIGHTEE catalogue, the existing extracted cube flux, or ALFALFA; report the original 47-object science sample separately from the 293-object parent catalogue.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE float64; sky coordinates in degrees, optical recession velocities in km/s, integrated fluxes in Jy km/s
mathematics.conventions: Frequency-derived MIGHTEE optical velocity c*(nu0/nu-1); FASHI v_opt. Nominal MIGHTEE Jy-Hz to Jy-km/s conversion c*nu0/nu^2 (OPT), with c/nu (REST) and c/nu0 (RADIO) reported as sensitivities because FASHI's integration-axis convention is not fully specified. FASHI S_bf and S_sum divided by 1000. No distance rescaling enters the flux ratios.
inputs: Public FASHI DR2 tables 2 and 3 and README
Existing 47 science-sample IDs from CFG301 stage A
mathematics.sample_definition: Retain all matches in the audit table. Primary reliable set requires FASHI SNR>=10, positive finite fluxes, unique candidates on both sides, and all five existing MIGHTEE quality flags zero. Clean subset additionally excludes a second MIGHTEE or FASHI source within 174 arcsec of FASHI centroid and an overlapping velocity interval (half sum of W50 plus 200 km/s). Report 47-object science-sample subset separately. Cube comparison additionally requires existing CFG302 primary and detected flags.
mathematics.summary: Median log10 flux ratios, object-bootstrap 68% and 95% intervals, robust scatter and paired three-survey comparison. Show direct-sum FASHI flux, velocity conventions, confusion, width consistency and match-radius sensitivities. Do not optimize cuts after seeing ratios.
mathematics.decision: Agreement band is +/-0.10 dex, inherited from the earlier comparison. Call a relative scale discrepant only if its 95% bootstrap interval lies beyond that band with at least 8 catalogue pairs (5 for cube comparisons); call compatible within band only if its 95% interval is contained in the band. Otherwise unresolved. A general resolution also requires direct-sum and clean/convention sensitivities to support the same conclusion; small clean subsets remain a limitation. Bootstrap intervals exclude shared calibration systematics, including the quoted approximately 5% FAST calibration floor.
non_claims: Does not measure a0 or prefer a gravity theory
Does not establish absolute calibration correctness from pairwise agreement alone
Does not treat multiple reductions of MIGHTEE as independent telescopes
Does not treat missing FASHI matches as zero flux or upper limits
Does not extrapolate the matched sample's correction to all 47 science objects
No sigma claim based solely on formal individual catalogue errors

pre_result_disclosures: Earlier ALFALFA result and sample cuts were read before defining this contract
FASHI generic catalogue headers and first rows outside COSMOS were inspected in the preceding scout
No COSMOS FASHI flux ratio has been inspected for this experiment
